import pytest

from prefect.utilities.text import fuzzy_match_string, truncated_to


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "length, value, expected",
    [
        (10, None, ""),
        (10, "", ""),
        (5, "hi", "hi"),
        (10, "abcdefghij", "abcdefghij"),
        # Short values are returned unchanged when the summarized form would not
        # actually be shorter than the original.
        (10, "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz", "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"),
        # Long values are summarized with the head, tail, and omitted count.
        (20, "x" * 200, "xxxxxxxxxx...180 additional characters...xxxxxxxxxx"),
        (10, "x" * 200, "xxxxx...190 additional characters...xxxxx"),
        (6, "a" * 100, "aaa...94 additional characters...aaa"),
        # Odd lengths use floor division for the head/tail halves.
        (11, "a" * 100, "aaaaa...90 additional characters...aaaaa"),
    ],
    ids=[
        "None returns empty string",
        "Empty string returns empty string",
        "Value shorter than length is unchanged",
        "Value equal to length is unchanged",
        "Value longer than length but not worth summarizing",
        "Long value is summarized",
        "Smaller length summarizes to a shorter head/tail",
        "Head and tail sized by half the length",
        "Odd length uses floor division",
    ],
)
def test_truncated_to(length, value, expected):
    result = truncated_to(length, value)
    assert result == expected
    # The result is never longer than the original value.
    assert len(result) <= len(value or "")
